name: priest_of_winter
description: a Priest of Winter (Fall from Heaven), an old cleric of the winter god: swept-back white hair and a long white beard, a heavy white robe with a thick cream fur collar and mantle, pale-blue trim and a pale-blue front panel with a white snowflake emblem, a grey sash with a round silver clasp, grey boots, and a tall silver staff topped with a glowing ice-blue crystal in his LEFT hand
hands: the crystal-topped silver staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side, gripped at chest height; his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist at his side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left, the crystal-topped silver staff thrown up and out in his left hand), the white beard and fur collar jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff tilting back, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the crystal-topped silver staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, white-haired head droops, the crystal-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees in the white robe, slumped forward, the crystal end of the silver staff resting on the ground, his empty right hand hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the silver staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the white beard on his chest; the crystal-topped silver staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the white fur robe spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white fur robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the crystal-topped silver staff on the ground beside him, its crystal dimmed
